locked_title: Investment Effectiveness Optimization Strategy based on Hybrid Multi-objective Evolution
scope: Retrospective specification of the preserved P5 implementation; this file is not a new experiment or a replacement for the archived run configuration.

decision_variable.definition: x_j=1 selects candidate position j from the scenario-local pool
decision_variable.identity_limit: event payloads use zero-based pool-local positions, not stable candidate identifiers

objectives.name: portfolio_risk
objectives.formula: mean_selected(rho_j), or 1 for an empty portfolio

quality_definition: q_j is the equal-share mean of the compliance and evidence proxy indices in the registered formulation

repair.iteration: drop one selected item with minimum score until budget violation is zero
repair.tie: selected positions are enumerated ascending; first argmin drops the smallest pool-local position
repair.event: append one repair_drop payload for each executed drop
repair.interpretation: deterministic proxy heuristic, not a unit-invariant benefit-cost or return estimator

reported_evaluation.bounds: empty portfolio, all singleton portfolios, and 2048 seeded random feasible portfolios, then 5 percent span padding

normalization.non_equivalence: generation-local preference normalization is not the fixed reported-evaluation normalization

preference.initialization: one mapped scenario vector plus seven Dirichlet(1,...,1) vectors
preference.scenario_mapping: normalize(cost,reliability,renewable,risk,compliance+evidence); load-support is not an objective coordinate
preference.best_response: first argmin of weighted generation-local normalized objectives plus penalty_lambda times budget violation
preference.replacement: if the best-response union row is absent, replace one seeded-uniform selected slot
preference.replacement_tie_or_priority: later preference vectors may evict rows restored for earlier vectors
preference.perturbation: componentwise absolute value after Normal(0,0.1^2 I), followed by L1 renormalization
preference.reselection: seed one of 2K candidate weights uniformly, then greedily maximize response-set minimum distance
preference.limitations: random initial candidate and retained-vector indices were not exported

environmental_selection.rule: constraint-dominated non-dominated sorting followed by descending crowding-distance truncation
environmental_selection.crowding_tie: no authored secondary criterion; executed NumPy ordering applies
environmental_selection.output_deduplication: lexicographic deduplication of feasible returned rows before final non-dominated front evaluation

evaluation_accounting.archived_equalities: TRACE-MOEA, NSGA-II, and R-NSGA-II share nominal population 40 and 40 generation labels; MOEA/D uses 35 directions
evaluation_accounting.claim_boundary: equal objective-function-call budgets are not claimed; deterministic methods have no stochastic evaluation-budget equivalence
evaluation_accounting.analysis_unit: one seeded method-scenario run for stochastic methods; one unique method-scenario output for deterministic rules

event_records.local_move_count: number of repair drops for P5
event_records.quarantine: no event field enters an objective, constraint, repair score, preference score, selection rule, or reported hypervolume
event_records.claim_boundary: counts and whole-run pool-position co-occurrence only; no chronology, lineage, replay, causation, auditability, or human-review value

objective_hiding_controls: NoReliabilityFeatures, NoRenewableFeatures, and NoScheduleRisk jointly change objective visibility and first-vector parameterization; they are combined controls only.

traceable_cost.legal: No source-specific license or redistribution record for a candidate-level cost corpus is present in this worktree.
traceable_cost.technical: No auditable candidate-to-record mapping or currency/base-year transformation exists; current k_j values remain synthetic units.
traceable_cost.prohibited_claim: actual return, audited cost effectiveness, currency-valued benefit, or calibrated investment economics

ac_or_opf.legal: Source URLs alone do not establish redistribution permission for a derived validation package; no stage-local license manifest is present.
ac_or_opf.technical: Portfolio bits select archetype proxies and do not specify bus, branch, generator, topology, dispatch, or control actions needed to modify and solve a network case.
ac_or_opf.prohibited_claim: AC-feasible, OPF-feasible, N-1 secure, or electrically validated portfolio

external_public_records.legal: Official URLs and metadata may be cited; this worktree does not establish permission to redistribute source PDFs or portal extracts, so only derived summaries and provenance links are in scope.
external_public_records.technical: Existing NERC and MTEP16 analyses have source reuse, label imbalance, and portfolio-dependence limits and no confirmatory randomization family.
external_public_records.allowed_claim: descriptive external consistency under the stated checks
external_public_records.prohibited_claim: actual return, above-chance portfolio performance, external validity, causal effectiveness, or deployment evidence
